controllerassist.tuning.title: Steering Tuning
controllerassist.tuning.help.title: Steering Tuning: Help
controllerassist.tuning.deadzone.help: How far you must move the wheel or stick from center before it counts as steering input. Prevents small resting drift on the axis from being read as a turn.
controllerassist.tuning.responsecurve.he: Shapes your direct steering input. 1.0 is linear. Above 1.0 the center is calmer and large inputs respond more, making small corrections easier without losing full lock. In Drift the chosen drift angle has its own curve.
controllerassist.tuning.speedref.help: Speed at which the maximum available steering angle reaches its lowest point (see Min. high-speed steer). Below this speed you get full steering. In Drift it also limits the maximum drift angle the same way.
controllerassist.tuning.minhighspeed.hel: How much steering range remains once the speed above is reached. Keeps high-speed turns from being too sharp. In Drift the maximum drift angle shrinks by the same fraction.
controllerassist.tuning.slipactivation.h: Rear slip angle at which the assist starts adding countersteer. Below it you drive unassisted.
controllerassist.tuning.slipfull.help: Rear slip angle at which the assist reaches full strength. Between activation and this value the countersteer ramps up smoothly.
controllerassist.tuning.countersteergain: How hard the assist counters a given slip angle. Higher feels faster and more aggressive; too high can feel jerky.
controllerassist.tuning.assiststrength.h: Overall multiplier for the assist's contribution. 0% is no help, 100% applies the full countersteer computed by the settings above.
controllerassist.tuning.minactivationspe: Below this speed the assist is off, so it doesn't interfere with slow maneuvering. It ramps in smoothly above it.
controllerassist.tuning.smoothing.help: Extra filtering applied after the rate limit above. Higher values make the output catch up to the target more slowly, at the cost of a little lag.
controllerassist.tuning.steerrateatspeed: Limits how fast your stick can move the wheels, in percent of full lock per second, at the speed reference and above. Below it the limit loosens in proportion, so at half the speed the wheels may move twice as fast. A quick flick of the stick then turns in smoothly instead of snapping the car. Assist corrections are not limited. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.spincatch.race.h: Adds countersteer as soon as the car starts to rotate past its path, before you notice the slide. It reacts when the body slip grows faster than about 8 degrees per second, from about 2 degrees of slip and above 30 km/h, which normal cornering almost never reaches. At 100% it adds up to half of full lock. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.allowedslip.help: How far the car may slide sideways (body slip angle) before spin catch and the throttle cut on rotation step in. 0 catches every slide as early as possible, for grip racing. Higher values leave room for power slides and light drifting, and only a slide that goes past this angle and keeps growing gets caught.
Takes throttle away from the right trigger when the car starts to rotate past its path (the same signal as spin catch), and gives it back smoothly once it settles. At 100% a fast rotation can cut the throttle completely. Throttle is only ever reduced, never added. Works in Race and Street and needs LFS throttle on the right trigger. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.throttleramp.hel: Makes the throttle build up gradually when you squeeze the trigger while steering, so a quick press on corner exit doesn't break the rear loose. At 100% and 40% steering or more, going from no throttle to full takes one second; with less steering it is proportionally quicker, and when driving straight it is instant. Lifting off is never delayed. 0 turns it off.
Takes throttle away from the right trigger when the driven wheels spin faster than the car moves, and gives it back smoothly once they grip again. It starts at 8% wheelspin, plus 1% for every degree of allowed slide, so Street lets the wheels spin more for power slides. At 100% heavy wheelspin can cut the throttle completely. Throttle is only ever reduced. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.brakesteer.help: How much of your steering is taken away at full brake and at the speed reference or above. Less brake or less speed takes away proportionally less. It calms the car when you brake into a corner, where a pad often turns in too hard while the rear is light. Assist corrections are not reduced. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.straightstabilit: When you let go of the stick above about 30 km/h, the assist gently steers against any leftover rotation so the car settles straight without a manual correction. It stays out of the way while you steer and during a real slide (body slip above 5 degrees), where countersteer takes over. The correction is at most 15% of full lock. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.frontgriplimit.h: Front slip angle above which extra steering from your stick is taken back, because the front tyres can't turn the car any harder. Past it the wheels stay near the grip limit instead of scrubbing, so the car turns in rather than ploughing on. Only your steering is reduced, never beyond straight, and only in the direction you steer. Around 6 to 8 degrees suits most cars. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.targetanglemax.h: The drift angle picked with the stick at full deflection. The assist tries to hold whatever angle you dial in, up to this maximum.
controllerassist.tuning.targetanglecurve: How stick deflection maps to the chosen drift angle. 1.0 is linear. Above 1.0 small stick movements pick small angles more precisely and the large angles are at the end of the travel.
How hard the assist corrects the difference between your chosen angle and the car's actual angle. Higher reacts faster and holds the angle more tightly; too high can oscillate. Angle hold smoothing takes the edge off.
controllerassist.tuning.targetanglesmoot: Filters only the angle hold correction, so sudden changes in the car's angle or quick stick flicks don't jerk the wheel. Direct steering stays sharp. Higher values are smoother but react later; too high can make the car wobble.
controllerassist.log.limit: The drift log stopped after 10 minutes.
controllerassist.tuning.correctionrate.h: Limits how fast the steering may change while the angle hold is in control, in percent of full lock per second. Stick movements during a drift go through the same limit, so the wheel no longer jumps when you correct. Outside a drift your stick stays direct, and the limit fades in with the hold. Lower values are smoother, but the assist catches the car later. 0 turns the limit off.
How slowly the angle hold lets go when the front slip drops. The hold still takes over at once when the slip grows, but hands the steering back gradually instead of jumping, which calms the wheel around the activation threshold and at drift exits. Too high a value keeps the hold on after the drift ends. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.stickrate.help: Limits how fast the drift angle picked with the stick may change, in degrees per second. A quick flick of the stick then moves the requested angle smoothly instead of kicking the correction. The assist still reacts at full speed to what the car does. Too low a value makes angle changes feel lazy. 0 turns the limit off.
controllerassist.tuning.spincatch.help: Adds extra countersteer when the car's drift angle grows quickly, before the car spins. It reacts to how fast the whole car rotates past its path, which the angle hold alone notices late. Normal drift angle changes are ignored, and it works only above about 20 degrees of drift angle and 15 km/h. Higher values catch earlier and harder, but can straighten the car when you want a bigger angle. 0 turns it off.
controllerassist.tuning.softsaturation.h: How gently the angle hold approaches full lock on large angle errors. At 0 the correction grows in a straight line and hits full lock abruptly. Higher values bend it smoothly towards full lock, so big corrections build up without a hard edge. Small corrections stay the same. Too high a value makes large corrections softer and later.
controllerassist.tuning.slipactivation.d: Rear slip angle at which the angle hold starts taking over from direct steering. Below it you steer the car yourself, for example to start a drift.
controllerassist.tuning.slipfull.drift.h: Rear slip angle at which the angle hold has fully taken over. Between activation and this value control passes smoothly from direct steering to the angle hold.
controllerassist.tuning.assiststrength.d: How much of the angle hold is applied once it has fully taken over. 100% lets the assist hold the angle on its own, lower values leave part of the direct steering in the mix.
controllerassist.rumble.title: Rumble Channels
controllerassist.rumble.help.title: Rumble Channels: Help
controllerassist.rumble.strength.help: Master volume for the whole vibration effect. Scales every channel below at once.
controllerassist.rumble.loadweight.help: How much the load channel contributes to the mix. It fires on sudden weight transfer, like the rear letting go in a slide.
controllerassist.rumble.roadweight.help: How much the road-texture channel contributes to the mix. It follows steady bumps and surface roughness through the suspension.
controllerassist.rumble.impactweight.hel: How much the impact channel contributes to the mix. It fires on sharp suspension spikes, like hitting a curb.
controllerassist.rumble.surfaceweight.he: How much the surface-change channel contributes to the mix. It fires specifically when the road texture suddenly changes, for example going onto grass or gravel.
controllerassist.rumble.shiftweight.help: How much the gear-shift channel contributes to the mix. It plays a short pulse on every gear change.
How sudden an acceleration change must be to trigger the load channel. Lower values react to softer snaps, higher values need a harder one.
controllerassist.rumble.loadslipactivati: Slip angle at which the load channel is allowed to start triggering. Below it, weight-transfer events are ignored.
controllerassist.rumble.loadslipfull.hel: Slip angle at which the load channel is allowed to reach full strength. Between activation and this value it ramps up.
controllerassist.rumble.roadgain.help: How sensitive the road-texture channel is to suspension movement. Lower values reach full strength on smaller bumps, higher values need rougher roads.
controllerassist.rumble.impactgain.help: How sensitive the impact channel is to suspension spikes. Lower values reach full strength on smaller hits, higher values need a harder one.
controllerassist.rumble.responsecurve.he: Shaping curve applied to every channel before mixing. 1.0 is linear. Above 1.0 weak effects feel softer and strong ones stand out more.
How much the vibration splits between the left and right motor based on which side carries the load. 0% keeps both motors equal, 100% makes it fully directional.

ach.title: Achievements
ach.subtitle: Hidden challenges and easter eggs
ach.secret.name: Secret achievement
ach.secret.desc: Nobody will tell you how to get this one.
ach.drift_first.name: Sideways Debut
ach.drift_first.desc: Your first drift. Mom would be proud. Or terrified.
ach.speed_200.name: Double Ton
ach.speed_200.desc: 200 km/h. The windows are still holding.
ach.speed_300.name: Outrun Your Shadow
ach.speed_300.desc: 300 km/h. Your thoughts stayed at the start line.
ach.speed_300.hint: Faster than you can think. Literally.
ach.rev_cuts_1000.name: Limiter's Best Friend
ach.rev_cuts_1000.desc: Two thousand ignition cuts. The pistons are asking for a holiday.
ach.cones_100.name: Cone Slayer
ach.cones_100.desc: Two hundred cones. The Cone Workers' Union declares mourning.
ach.kiss.name: Smooch
ach.kiss.desc: Touched another car below 3 km/h. Almost romantic.
ach.kiss.hint: Sometimes a gentle touch is all it takes.
ach.roof.name: Upside Down
ach.roof.desc: Car on its roof. The view is more interesting than usual.
ach.resets_20.name: Reset Enthusiast
ach.resets_20.desc: Twenty resets in one session. Maybe someone else should drive?
ach.resets_20.hint: Once more. And again. And again...
ach.air_1.name: Flight School
ach.air_1.desc: One and a half seconds in the air. The wheels forgot about the ground.
ach.night_owl.name: Night Owl
ach.night_owl.desc: A drift between 2 and 5 AM. The neighbours sleep, you don't.
ach.donut_10.name: Bakery Shift
ach.donut_10.desc: Fifteen donuts in a row. Your tyres just handed in their notice.
ach.donut_10.hint: Sweet, round and fifteen times in a row.
ach.drift_90.name: Sideways Lifestyle
ach.drift_90.desc: 90 degrees for 3 seconds. The steering wheel no longer knows where the front is.
ach.reverse_60.name: Reverse Hero
ach.reverse_60.desc: 60 km/h in reverse. Your mirrors are the new windscreen.
ach.tbone.name: Cannonball
ach.tbone.desc: A crash at 130 km/h closing speed. Your insurer is crying.
ach.tbone.hint: Two cars, one spot, zero braking.
ach.wall.name: Wall Wins
ach.wall.desc: Over 15 g of impact. The wall didn't even flinch.
ach.wall.hint: Some things are harder than your determination.
ach.handbrake_250.name: Bold Choice
ach.handbrake_250.desc: Handbrake at 250 km/h and you survived. Don't try it again.
ach.handbrake_250.hint: That lever isn't for parking. Not today.
ach.rev_hold_10.name: Neighbours Called the Police
ach.rev_hold_10.desc: 15 seconds on the rev limiter. The next village can hear you.
ach.blinker_2km.name: Eternal Blinker
ach.blinker_2km.desc: Three kilometres with the indicator on. Forgot about it? We didn't.
ach.launch.name: Launch Control
ach.launch.desc: 0-100 km/h in under 3.5 seconds. Your neck won't forget it.
ach.barrel_roll.name: Stuntman
ach.barrel_roll.desc: A full barrel roll and a landing on all four wheels. Free action movie.
ach.burnout_smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
ach.burnout_smokehouse.desc: Fifteen seconds of burning rubber on the spot. The sausages are ready.
ach.burnout_marathon.name: Rubber Marathon
ach.burnout_marathon.desc: Forty-five seconds of burnout. Your tyres are keeping a casualty log.
ach.burnout_marathon.hint: The smoke never ends. Neither does your patience.
ach.burnout_carousel.name: Merry-Go-Round
ach.burnout_carousel.desc: Fifteen spins in the smoke in a row. The funfair is open.
ach.burnout_carousel.hint: Spin, spin, until the rubber runs out.
ach.burnout_to_drift.name: Smoke Entry
ach.burnout_to_drift.desc: A burnout that flowed straight into a drift. Zero pause, one hundred percent style.
ach.burnout_to_drift.hint: Smoke first, sideways next. No break.
ach.air_3.name: Houston, We Have a Problem
ach.air_3.desc: Four seconds in the air. NASA called asking about your programme.
ach.air_3.hint: Some aim high. You aim long.
ach.air_total_60.name: LFS Airlines
ach.air_total_60.desc: Two full minutes in the air in total. Miles earned, luggage lost.
ach.roof_landing.name: A Cat Would Do Better
ach.roof_landing.desc: A flight that ended on the roof. At least cats land on their feet.
ach.cones_1000.name: Cone Apocalypse
ach.cones_1000.desc: Two thousand cones. The cone factory is running three shifts.
ach.tyres_500.name: Wholesale Tyre Service
ach.tyres_500.desc: A thousand tyres and tyre stacks hit. The tyre shop owner bought a new house.
ach.barriers_250.name: Barrier Repairs On You
ach.barriers_250.desc: Five hundred barrier hits. The invoice is on its way.
ach.signs_200.name: Signs? What Signs?
ach.signs_200.desc: Four hundred signs and posts flattened. Reading isn't your strong suit.
ach.signs_200.hint: Rules are there to be... run over?
ach.bins_50.name: Bin Day
ach.bins_50.desc: One hundred bins sent flying. The council is considering hiring you.
ach.bins_50.hint: Someone has to take out the trash.
ach.hay_100.name: Harvest Season
ach.hay_100.desc: Two hundred hay bales. The farmer can't decide whether to thank you or call the police.
ach.hay_100.hint: Country life needs drift skills too.
ach.ambulance.name: At Least Help Is Nearby
ach.ambulance.desc: You hit the ambulance. Fastest call-out ever.
ach.strike.name: Strike!
ach.strike.desc: Ten objects in two seconds. The bowling alley asks you to keep it down.
ach.strike.hint: Ten pins, one ball, zero mercy.
ach.run_100k.name: Six-Figure Run
ach.run_100k.desc: One hundred and fifty thousand points in a single run. The calculator asked for a break.
ach.run_250k.name: Quarter Million, One Breath
ach.run_250k.desc: Two hundred and fifty thousand points in one run. Legends are already being told.
ach.run_250k.hint: One run. A very, very long one.
ach.combo_max.name: Hit the Ceiling
ach.combo_max.desc: x10 multiplier. It doesn't go higher, we checked.
ach.combo_max.hint: The scale has an end. Find it.
ach.combo_hold_30.name: Life at the Top
ach.combo_hold_30.desc: x10 multiplier held for 45 seconds. Collect your crown at the exit.
ach.combo_hold_30.hint: Reaching the top is one thing. Staying there is another.
ach.bonus_5.name: Bonus Festival
ach.bonus_5.desc: Six bonuses on screen at once. The HUD is asking for a holiday.
ach.bonus_5.hint: One bonus is luck. Six at once is style.
ach.pit_contact.name: The Pit Lane Is Not a Track
ach.pit_contact.desc: Contact with another car in the pit lane. The mechanics are already collecting mirrors.
ach.pit_contact.hint: The most dangerous place on the circuit? The one next to the garages.
ach.pileup_3.name: Pile-Up
ach.pileup_3.desc: Three different cars in three seconds. Insurers are calling an emergency meeting.
ach.pileup_3.hint: One is an accident. Three is an event.
ach.roof_spawn.name: World Record Rollover
ach.roof_spawn.desc: On the roof less than 10 seconds after a reset. Impressive. In the wrong way.
ach.reverse_500m.name: Wrong Way
ach.reverse_500m.desc: A full kilometre in reverse. Your satnav has given up.
ach.reverse_500m.hint: Everyone's going the wrong way. Except you. Probably.

diag.write.title: Saving files
diag.write.ok: The app can save its files in {0}.
diag.write.error: The app cannot save files in {0}. Settings, scores and achievements will not be saved. Details: {1}
diag.write.help: Move the whole app folder to a place where you can save files, for example C:\Games\LFS Drift Tools, and start it from there.
diag.write.help.cfa: The folder is in Documents, Pictures or on the Desktop: Windows Defender Controlled folder access may be blocking it. You can also allow LFSDriftTools.exe in Windows Security > Ransomware protection.
diag.location.title: App folder location
diag.location.ok: The app folder is in a normal location.
diag.location.programfiles: The app is in Program Files. Windows does not let programs save their own files there.
diag.location.onedrive: The app is in a folder synced by OneDrive. Syncing can lock settings files or bring back old versions.
diag.location.temp: The app runs from a temporary folder. Windows can delete it together with your settings.
diag.location.zip: The app seems to run directly from a zip file. Extract the whole zip first.
diag.location.help: Move the whole app folder, for example to C:\Games\LFS Drift Tools, and start it from there.
diag.rights.title: Rights compared to LFS
diag.rights.ok: LFS and the app run with the same rights.
diag.rights.nolfs: LFS is not running. The app checks again when it sends keys to LFS.
diag.rights.unknown: The rights of LFS could not be checked.
diag.rights.error: LFS runs as administrator and the app does not. Windows blocks the keys the app sends to LFS (rev limiter, turn signals) and key bindings while LFS is in front.
diag.rights.blocked: Windows blocked keys sent to LFS during this session. LFS most likely runs as administrator and the app does not.
diag.rights.appadmin: The app runs as administrator and LFS does not. This works, but it is not needed.
diag.rights.help: Start LFS and the app the same way: both normally (recommended) or both as administrator. Check that "Run this program as an administrator" is off in the compatibility settings of LFS.exe.
diag.ports.title: OutGauge and OutSim ports
diag.ports.off: {0} is turned off in the app.
diag.ports.busy: {0} cannot use port {1}: it is used by {2}.
diag.ports.help: Close the other program or choose another port in the app, then use Configure LFS cfg and restart LFS.
diag.hook.title: Key bindings
diag.hook.ok: The app can watch the keyboard for your key bindings.
diag.hook.error: Windows or an antivirus program did not let the app watch the keyboard (error {0}). Key bindings and turn signal keys do not work.
diag.hook.help: Add an exception for the app folder in your antivirus program and restart the app.
diag.env.title: System
status.lfs.keys_blocked: Windows blocked keys sent to LFS. LFS most likely runs as administrator and the app does not: start both the same way. Details: Diagnostics.
status.udp_port_in_use: Port {0} is already used by {1}. Close it or choose another port, then configure LFS again.
status.udp_port_in_use_unknown: Port {0} is already used by another program. Close it or choose another port, then configure LFS again.
diag.lfs.title: Connection to LFS
diag.lfs.notrunning: LFS is not running. Start LFS and check again.
diag.lfs.insim.off: InSim is turned off in the app.
diag.lfs.insim.waiting: LFS is running, but InSim is not connected. In LFS type /insim {0} or check the port in the app.
diag.lfs.og.idle: No OutGauge data right now. This is normal in menus, in the garage, in replays, while paused or while watching another car.
diag.lfs.og.missing: You are driving, but no OutGauge data has arrived for over {0} s. Check OutGauge in cfg.txt and restart LFS.
diag.lfs.os.idle: No OutSim2 data right now. LFS sends it only while you drive your own car.
diag.lfs.os.missing: You are driving, but no OutSim2 data has arrived for over {0} s. Controller Assist needs it: check OutSim in cfg.txt and restart LFS.
diag.lfs.help: Use Configure LFS cfg in the InSim Connection card and restart LFS. InSim also needs the /insim command in LFS (see README).
diag.cfg.title: LFS cfg.txt
diag.cfg.nofolder: The LFS game folder is not set, so cfg.txt is not checked.
diag.cfg.nofile: cfg.txt was not found in the LFS game folder.
diag.cfg.help: Use Configure LFS cfg in the InSim Connection card, then restart LFS.
diag.drivers.title: Controller Assist drivers
diag.drivers.notused: Controller Assist is off, its drivers are not needed.
diag.drivers.ok: The drivers Controller Assist needs are installed.
diag.drivers.novigem: ViGEmBus is not installed, so Controller Assist cannot create the virtual pad.
diag.drivers.nohidhide: HidHide is not installed, so the physical pad cannot be hidden from LFS.
diag.drivers.help: Install the missing driver from the Controller Assist card.
diag.padtools.title: Programs that take over the gamepad
diag.padtools.none: No known gamepad tools are running.

diag.telemetry.title: Other telemetry programs

diag.telemetry.found: Running: {0}. If OutGauge or OutSim2 data does not arrive, they may use the same ports.
diag.window.title: LFS display mode

diag.window.fullscreen: LFS runs in full screen. The overlay (score, speedometer, steering bar) may not be visible on top of it.
diag.window.help: Switch LFS to windowed mode in its display options.

diag.av.none: Windows Security Center reports no antivirus.
